overview_description.description:
Zenedy was started as a means to showcase information about obscure topics from around the web. Every day, millions of people are searching for information on the Internet, and many times finding little or no quality content returned to them. We aim to identify when that happens, and then provide high quality articles on these obscure, yet interesting, topics.

Our motto is “learn something new every day,” and we practice what we preach by adding new articles to the site every day about everything you could imagine. You never know when something that peaks your interest will come along, so be sure to subscribe to Zenedy email updates and follow Zenedy on Twitter to be sure you don’t missing something interesting! Enjoy the site!
